truth_boundary.truth_policy: Ground truth may be captured and joined with timestamped operational outputs only by evaluation tools. It must not be bridged to ROS or read by an operational node, planner, controller, mission manager, or launch path.

metrics.definition: Euclidean XY distance between timestamp-aligned estimated rover pose and Gazebo reference pose.
metrics.reference: Gazebo model pose joined by simulation timestamp; maximum nearest-sample skew 0.02 s.

metrics.definition: Absolute wrapped yaw difference between timestamp-aligned estimated and Gazebo reference pose.
metrics.reference: Gazebo model pose joined by simulation timestamp; maximum nearest-sample skew 0.02 s.

metrics.definition: Absolute difference between estimated-path and reference-path arc length over the same trial interval.

gate.reason: Freeze scenario-specific limits before P10-02 trials.

metrics.definition: Arc length traveled over a trial interval; preserve estimated and reference path lengths separately.
metrics.reference: Timestamped odometry for the estimate and aligned Gazebo model poses for the reference; planner-grid path length is labeled separately.

gate.reason: The P10 grid suite reports planner path length only; freeze mission-level gates after runtime trials.

metrics.definition: Elapsed simulation time from trial motion start to accepted mission completion.
metrics.reference: Scenario start/end events aligned to Gazebo simulation clock; wall-clock duration is reported separately.

gate.reason: No common timestamped runtime duration is available across all five scenarios.

metrics.definition: Scenario acceptance state from mission lifecycle and durable goal/delivery evidence.
metrics.reference: Scenario manifest and mission event journal; reference poses and required events are frozen before a trial.

gate.reason: P10-02 freezes planner-fixture checks; live scenario mission gates remain unverified.

metrics.definition: Number of rover contacts with scenario-defined obstacle bodies during a trial.
metrics.reference: Gazebo contact/collision records; unavailable unless the trial records this source.

gate.reason: Do not infer zero contacts from absent contact data.

metrics.definition: Minimum rover-footprint distance to the nearest known obstacle over the evaluated path.
metrics.reference: Scenario obstacle geometry and timestamp-aligned rover reference pose; report sensor-map estimate separately.

gate.reason: Physical footprint margins and pose-aligned obstacle geometry remain unmeasured in the planner fixture suite.

metrics.definition: Reference-pose samples whose rover footprint intersects a scenario-labeled unsafe region.
metrics.reference: Frozen scenario terrain annotation and timestamp-aligned Gazebo pose.

gate.reason: P10-02 freezes grid risk regions; physical terrain annotations and rover-footprint rule remain unverified.

metrics.definition: Distance and fraction of the route footprint occupying each labeled terrain or risk class.
metrics.reference: Frozen scenario terrain labels aligned to timestamped rover reference poses; planner cost-region exposure is a separate proxy.

gate.reason: The fixture suite records planned risk-region intersections only, not rover footprint exposure.

metrics.definition: Per-class intersection-over-union and mean IoU over labeled pixels, excluding ignore labels.
metrics.reference: Frozen, scene-separated held-out masks; report each class and support.

metrics.definition: Number of obstacle-triggered replans and elapsed time from obstacle-map revision to changed safe plan publication.
metrics.reference: Timestamped obstacle-map revision, plan revision, and monitor events; report instrumentation boundaries.

gate.reason: P7-03 supplies planner-only timing; live ROS/Gazebo end-to-end timing remains unmeasured.

metrics.definition: Recovery attempts, recovery success, and unresolved blocked/fault outcomes.
metrics.reference: Mission lifecycle transition and event journal.

gate.reason: P10-02 did not trigger recovery in its planner fixture scenarios.

metrics.definition: CPU utilization, resident memory, peak GPU memory, measured callback/inference latency, and simulation real-time factor.
metrics.reference: Host process counters, accelerator provider counters when available, monotonic timestamps, and simulator clock.

gate.reason: Freeze laptop resource and real-time limits in P11-01.
